title: 1827 Prairie's porch gets its stone arches and front steps
items: The Doane house's porch at 1827 Prairie is now a stone arcade, as the old photograph shows it: two round arches across the front on three columns, and a third arch on its south side.
Its steps now climb straight in from the street under the south front arch, between stone cheeks, where before a flight ran across the porch's whole width.
